decision_rule.flag_pack_heterogeneity_review_if: primary Welch 95% CI excludes zero and abs(pack difference) exceeds 0.002, or any surface max-t adjusted p-value <= 0.05 and abs(pack difference) exceeds 0.002
decision_rule.pooling_policy: always report v3-only and v4-only estimates; pooled result is labeled secondary when the flag fires

estimand: mean v4-r2 treatment-minus-control effect minus mean v3 treatment-minus-control effect
primary_method: two-sided Welch Student-t interval for independent pack means

surface_method.method: centered within-pack nonparametric bootstrap max absolute Welch-t over all 75 fixed contrasts
